description:
Sends a sample alert mail (two made-up events, "Sample" in the subject) at once and outside the queue to every current alert recipient, each in their own language. At most 5 requests a minute. Every recipient is tried: when some fail, the answer is a 400 with the (scrubbed) reply for the first failure and its address in message_values.address, the number that failed in message_values.failed and the number of mails that went out in message_values.sent. Answers 400 with error.notify-no-recipients when nobody gets alert mails.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)

200.description: The sample was handed to the server for every recipient

sent.description: The number of recipients the sample went to
